answer: **1**  (([A friend you haven't seen since June: “What have you been up to?” Your news: a new job · started: August.]))
((You:)) I**'ve got a new job**! I **started** in August.
((Новость без времени → present perfect; деталь со временем → past simple. Тоже верно: I changed jobs in August.))
**2**  (([Your friend: “I've just got back from Croatia!” Ask **two** questions about the trip.]))
((You:)) Oh, nice! **When did you go?** **Who did you go with?**
((Детали → past simple: When did you…? Who did you go with? How was it?))

blocks.instr: Snakes and ladders: take turns to roll the dice and move. Do the task on your square, then tap to check.
blocks.rule: Ladder + right answer = go up. Snake + wrong answer = go down. First to the top wins!

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: I've been really busy. **+ since September**
tasks.a: I've been really busy since September.
tasks.why: No change: since September — до сих пор.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: We've finally managed to get away for a couple of weeks. **+ in August**
tasks.a: We finally managed to get away for a couple of weeks in August.
tasks.why: The tense changes: in August — законченное время.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: Work has been crazy. **+ this autumn**
tasks.a: Work has been crazy this autumn.
tasks.why: No change: осень ещё не закончилась.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: I haven't had a day off. **+ for ages**
tasks.a: I haven't had a day off for ages.
tasks.why: No change: for ages — «сто лет», до сих пор.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: We've had a lovely change of scenery. **+ over the summer**
tasks.a: We had a lovely change of scenery over the summer.
tasks.why: The tense changes: over the summer — лето закончилось.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: I've started a new course. **+ a week ago**
tasks.a: I started a new course a week ago.
tasks.why: The tense changes: ago → past simple.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: I've caught up with some old friends. **+ last weekend**
tasks.a: I caught up with some old friends last weekend.
tasks.why: The tense changes: last weekend — законченное время.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: I've been to a lovely café with Anna. **+ two days ago**
tasks.a: I went to a lovely café with Anna two days ago.
tasks.why: The tense changes: ago — всегда past simple.

tasks.label: Add the time
tasks.q: Have you managed to get away? **+ this summer** (([It's November now.]))
tasks.a: Did you manage to get away this summer?
tasks.why: The tense changes: лето закончилось → и вопрос в past simple.

tasks.label: Our sentence: say it right
tasks.q: When ~~have you started~~ your new job?
tasks.a: When did you start your new job?

tasks.label: Our sentence: say it right
tasks.q: I ~~'ve been~~ to the museum a week ago.
tasks.a: I went to the museum a week ago.
tasks.why: A week ago — законченное время → past simple. Сравни: I've been to a great exhibition! (новость, без времени).

tasks.label: Our sentence: say it right
tasks.q: I ~~'ve given up~~ after episode three.
tasks.a: I gave up after episode three.
tasks.why: After episode three — законченный момент → past simple.

blocks.instr: Round 2: your real news. Then swap roles.
items: **1**  Tell your partner **two** pieces of news from the last few weeks (present perfect: I've…).
**2**  Your partner asks **two** questions about each piece of news in the past simple, e.g. When…? Who with? How was it?
**3**  Then ask your partner one question from the table that you haven't asked yet.
blocks.fast: If you're done: go back to Anna in 🔁 Recall and say the missing words from memory. Then tell your partner about **two** things you've done for the first time this year. When did you do them? How did it go?
